slides.2.componentProps.slide.title: 📋 Level 3 Assessment
What do Santorini's kouloura and koulouraki share as a purpose?
A. Resist strong northerly winds and protect the fruit
Both are low-training responses to wind.
The minimum Assyrtiko share in Santorini PDO dry white?
The minimum oxidative maturation for Vinsanto?
It also needs sun-dried over-ripe grapes of at least 370 g/L sugar.
A Naoussa containing another grape is declassified to…
A. Imathia PGI or Macedonia PGI
What are the PGI sourcing share and levels?
A. At least 85%; Regional, District, Area
A. Moschofilero on a 650–800 m plateau
B. Assyrtiko on a volcanic island
The best statement comparing Xinomavro and Nebbiolo?
A. Similar structure (pale, high acid and tannin, ageworthy) but different terroir and aroma
The Diploma favours naming both likenesses and differences.
Roughly what share of Greek output do PDO and PGI make up together?
D. The same as the EU average
Far below the 80%+ of other EU producers.
The largest block for Greek wine exports in 2023?
The top five are Germany, Cyprus, France, the Netherlands and Belgium.
How did Santorini's Assyrtiko output change recently?
A. From about 2,500 t in 2022 to about 500 t in 2025
The cause was heat and drought in 2023–2025.
The safest way to cite figures?
A. Use official figures and state year and source
For instance PDO counts: 28 in a 2018 text, 33 today.
Per the source, how long are the two D3 theory papers?
D. There is no theory paper
Always confirm the exam format against current official WSET documents.
